question: When a watch is sold at (7)/(11)of the marked price, there is a loss of 20%. What is the ratio of the market price to the cost price of this watch?
solution:

Selling price (SP) of article = (7/11) of Market Price (MP)

Loss percentage = 20%

Concept used:

Profit% = [(SP - CP) / CP] × 100

where

SP = Selling price

CP = Cost price
